Placement from snapshot 2026-09-27T030805Z (CSV plus raw properties; Deviations 22, 26 and 46 cuts plus the Deviation 53 coherence floor T1, T2 >= 25 us, on the newest committed calibration data; Deviation 62: qubits outside a rectangle's largest connected live-coupler component are holes): n20 = 4x5 n = 20 origin (2, 0) edge 32_42 broken [[31, 32], [41, 51]]; n100 = 10x10 n = 88 origin (2, 0) edge 75_85 broken [[86, 87], [100, 101], [31, 32], [95, 96], [41, 51], [69, 79], [87, 97], [100, 110], [79, 89]]. Budget model v3 (Deviation 47: 3.0 s per job, +2.7 s at resilience >= 1, 5 us per execution, max(shots, 64) at resilience >= 1), jobs of at most 300 pubs (max_experiments; Deviation 48) and 12 MB of parameter values: 6 jobs, 1200 pubs, 2400 parameter sets, 9830400 executions (+0 TREX), 2.001 min at the booked 1 us rep_delay (42.797 min at 250 us). Nothing is submitted while dry_run is true and the pre-flight review permalink is the placeholder.
